## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure robotics engineering without HRI
- AI use without disclosure per Springer policy
- No user study evidence

### Soft Tax

Low for HRI tradition.

### Best Suited For

- HRI empirical research
- Robot ethics
- Social robot design
- Care / education / companion robotics
- Anthropomorphism research

### Not Recommended For

- Pure robotics engineering (consider IEEE Robotics)
- Pure HCI without robot focus (consider TOCHI)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Interaction Studies](./interaction-studies.md) | HRI + linguistics; Benjamins |
| 2 | [AI & Society](./ai-and-society.md) | If robot ethics focus; Springer |
| 3 | [ACM Transactions on Human-Robot Interaction](../hci/acm-transactions-on-human-robot-interaction.md) | ACM HRI flagship |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from ACM/IEEE robotics as "too HCI-focused," IJSR is the Springer HRI community home.
